portInfo.description: Sharm El Sheikh Port (UNCTAD EGSSH) sits on the southern Sinai Red Sea coast. The Maritime Transport & Logistics Sector page publishes coordinates 27°51.2′N / 34°17′E, lists passenger berths 1 (570 m) and 2 (116 m), and notes yacht gates and basic marine services. MedCruise’s Egyptian Ports facts instead give maximum ship dimensions 215 m length, 32 m width, 7.7 m draught, four quays totalling 605 m at ~8 m depth, one passenger terminal, and tenders allowed (no tugs listed). Both sources are retained; ships must follow the line’s declared draught/LOA limits. AD Ports Group stated on 19 May 2026 that cruise terminal services commenced at Sharm and that Aroya docked directly after Ministry of Transport / RSPA docking upgrades. Door GPS null.
